blocks.md: This lesson covers the book's section on **Which Physical Budget Binds First**. Read the excerpt, then test yourself below.

blocks.source: Vol IV, The Physical Body, § Which Physical Budget Binds First
blocks.md: A single command from an action-chunking policy to accelerate a loaded mobile manipulator draws concurrently against all five physical budgets, which is why the simultaneous admission invariant of a later section admits it only when every margin is non-negative at once. The command executes against a camera frame that has already aged during neural inference, so that age enters the pre-brake delay. At the same time, the acceleration injects kinetic energy into the chassis, which friction brakes or regenerative drives must eventually dissipate.

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Limit record matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: A physical limit governs an admission decision only as a six-element record (value, conditions, uncertainty, margin, runtime detector, provenance with evidence category), and uncertainty about the measurement is distinct from margin held in reserve.

questions.q: The section **Which Physical Budget Binds First** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Before torque reaches a winding the permission path must find non-negative margin in all five physical budgets at once (observation age, stopping distance, deliverable torque, winding temperature, supply), because one budget's slack never pays another's deficit.

An observation's age runs from physical transduction to actuator torque onset and must stay under the freshness deadline E_max / v_max set by the target's speed and the spatial tolerance, with inference only one of many stages.

Compute and drives share one DC bus whose impedance turns a coincident current step into droop toward converter lockout while a regenerative stop pumps energy back, so the permission rail is isolated and held up and every unpowered state is specified.

A physical limit governs an admission decision only as a six-element record (value, conditions, uncertainty, margin, runtime detector, provenance with evidence category), and uncertainty about the measurement is distinct from margin held in reserve.
